verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev's own documented self-hosting option lets users run the platform on their own infrastructure, which by implication lets them decide where task data lives. The evidence never mentions region selection or data residency for the managed cloud, so residency control is only achievable by taking on self-hosting. Missing for 10: cloud region/residency selection, explicit data-residency documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Self-hosting Trigger.dev means you run and manage the platform on your own infrastructure, giving you full control over your environment
You can self-host Trigger.dev on your own infrastructure using Docker.
